papers.title: Comparative study of fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V specimens built by electron beam melting (EBM) and selective laser melting (SLM)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接比较了EBM和SLM两种增材制造工艺下Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能，对评估生物医学植入物的疲劳寿命有重要参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and lacks implant-specific context.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较EBM和SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能，评估工艺适用性。
summary_zh.method: 对EBM和SLM试样进行疲劳测试及微观组织表征。
summary_zh.result: SLM试样因更细的微观组织和更少的缺陷而具有更高的疲劳强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳试验和微观结构分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the fatigue properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by electron beam melting and selective laser melting for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Fatigue tests were conducted on specimens built by EBM and SLM under identical conditions, followed by microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: SLM specimens exhibited superior fatigue strength attributed to finer microstructure and fewer internal defects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing and microstructural analysis were performed.

papers.title: Facile Biofabrication of Heterogeneous Multilayer Tubular Hydrogels by Fast Diffusion-Induced Gelation
papers.abstract: Multilayer (ML) hydrogels are useful to achieve stepwise and heterogeneous control over the organization of biomedical materials and cells. There are numerous challenges in the development of fabrication approaches toward this, including the need for mild processing conditions that maintain the integrity of embedded compounds and the versatility in processing to introduce desired complexity. Here, we report a method to fabricate heterogeneous multilayered hydrogels based on diffusion-induced gelation. This technique uses the quick diffusion of ions and small molecules (i.e., photoinitiators) through gel–sol or gel–gel interfaces to produce hydrogel layers. Specifically, ionically (e.g., alginate-based) and covalently [e.g., gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA-based)] photocross-linked hydrogels are generated in converse directions from the same interface. The ML (e.g., seven layers) ionic hydrogels can be formed within seconds to minutes with thicknesses ranging from tens to hundreds of micrometers. The thicknesses of the covalent hydrogels are determined by the reaction time (or the molecule diffusion time). Multiwalled tubular structures (e.g., mimicking branched multiwalled vessels) are mainly investigated in this study based on a removable gel core, but this method can be generalized to other material patterns. The process is also demonstrated to support the encapsulation of viable cells and is compatible with a range of thermally reversible core materials (e.g., gelatin and Pluronic F127) and covalently cross-linked formulations (e.g., GelMA and methacrylated hyaluronic acid). This biofabrication process enhances our ability to fabricate a range of structures that are useful for biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及AI或机器学习，仅描述了一种基于扩散诱导凝胶化的生物制造方法，与AI生物打印研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a fabrication method for multilayer hydrogels with no AI/ML integration, no bioprinting workflow stage, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发温和条件下快速制备多层异质管状水凝胶的方法
summary_zh.method: 利用离子和小分子通过凝胶界面快速扩散引发凝胶化
summary_zh.result: 数秒至数分钟内形成厚度可控的多层水凝胶，支持细胞封装
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活性和多层管状结构成像验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a mild and rapid fabrication method for heterogeneous multilayer tubular hydrogels for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: The method relies on rapid diffusion of ions and photoinitiators across gel-sol or gel-gel interfaces to induce ionic and covalent crosslinking in opposite directions.
summary_en.result: Multilayer hydrogels with up to seven layers and tunable thickness (tens to hundreds of micrometers) are formed within seconds to minutes, and cell encapsulation is demonstrated.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated by fabricating multiwalled tubular structures with viable encapsulated cells and compatibility with various thermoreversible core materials.

papers.title: Study on Grindability of Inconel 718 Superalloy Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting (SLM)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造的Inconel 718超合金的可磨削性，属于航空材料加工领域，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等方向完全无关。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the grindability of Inconel 718 superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM).
summary_en.method: Grinding experiments were conducted on SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 under various process parameters.
summary_en.result: The grinding performance of SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 was compared with wrought material, showing differences in grinding forces and surface integrity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of grinding forces, surface roughness, and microhardness.

papers.title: Analysis of relation between the 3D printer laser beam power and the surface morphology properties in Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy parts
papers.abstract: Additive technologies are increasingly widespread in the aviation industry, medicine and implantology. It is essential that the parts manufactured for these applications meet the highest requirements not only as far as their strength, but also surface quality. Thus, high importance should be attached to performing analysis of the manufactured part’s surface morphology to ensure optimised functionality, and to selecting appropriate post-processes so as to arrive at the required external surface structure. The paper aims to establish the influence of technological parameters (chiefly of the laser power) of the selective laser melting (SLM) process on the morphological properties of the manufactured surfaces. The changes of characteristics of the Sa and Sq parameters in the laser power P function are non-linear. However, for some values of laser power P (150, 175 W), the Sa and Sq parameters are considerably higher than that in case of the remaining laser power values. The change of the laser power has a strong influence on the structure of individual surfaces, as evidenced by the fact that the highest values of the Sa and Sq parameters were achieved at different laser powers (175 W for the top surface and 150 W for the side surface). The results are shown in graphic form of 2D and 3D morphology profiles and charts. Based on the analysis of parameters describing surface structure properties, optimum values of laser power during SLM process are established. The study also revealed that surface structure analysis should not be focused solely on basic parameters such as average height (Sa) or root-mean-square height (Sq), but also on parameters such as kurtosis (Sku) and skewness (Ssk), which yield important information on surface stereometry. Precisely established surface stereometry allows assessing properties such as wear resistance, corrosion, tribological properties, and the ability to integrate medical implants with live organism tissue.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM钛合金表面形貌与工艺参数的关系，虽未直接涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，但表面粗糙度对骨整合有影响，可作为背景参考。
llm.why_not_core: Does not investigate porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or osseointegration in a biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立激光功率与SLM钛合金表面形貌的关系
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率制备Ti-6Al-4V试样，测量表面粗糙度参数
summary_zh.result: 激光功率显著影响表面形貌，最佳参数取决于表面方向
summary_zh.validation: 通过2D/3D形貌图和参数比较验证

summary_en.motivation: To establish the relationship between laser power and surface morphology of SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V parts.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated at varying laser powers, and surface roughness parameters (Sa, Sq, Sku, Ssk) were measured.
summary_en.result: Laser power non-linearly affects surface roughness, with optimal values depending on the surface orientation (top vs. side).
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization using 2D/3D profilometry and statistical analysis.
